# Perspective Developers

> Perspective is a mobile-first funnel builder for marketing and recruiting. This site documents the REST API and the MCP server that AI assistants use to operate Perspective on a user's behalf.

## Docs

- [Introduction](https://www.perspective.co/developers/): What you can build with the Perspective API and MCP server.
- [Quickstart](https://www.perspective.co/developers/quickstart): First API call in 5 minutes.
- [MCP Server](https://www.perspective.co/developers/mcp): Connect Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor.
- [Authentication](https://www.perspective.co/developers/authentication): Bearer-token auth.
- [API Reference](https://www.perspective.co/developers/api-reference): Every endpoint.
- [Webhooks](https://www.perspective.co/developers/webhooks): Real-time events.
- [Errors](https://www.perspective.co/developers/errors): Error codes and rate limits.
- [Changelog](https://www.perspective.co/developers/changelog): Latest API updates.
